import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                          hue='BMI Category', s=100, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
occupation_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_metrics))
width = 0.25
ax2.bar(x - width, occupation_metrics['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', alpha=0.8)
ax2.bar(x, occupation_metrics['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', alpha=0.8)
ax2.bar(x + width, occupation_metrics['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', alpha=0.8)

ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(occupation_metrics.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Disorders
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(disorder_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Disorders', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Correlation Heatmap
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
correlation_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(correlation_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numeric Features', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Gender
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
scatter2 = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level', 
                           hue='Gender', style='Gender', s=100, alpha=0.7, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Gender', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)

# 6. Age Distribution with Sleep Quality
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
age_bins = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65])
age_group_data = df.groupby(age_bins).agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean'
})

x_age = np.arange(len(age_group_data))
ax6_secondary = ax6.twinx()
bars = ax6.bar(x_age - 0.15, age_group_data['Sleep Duration'], 0.3, 
               alpha=0.7, label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue')
line = ax6_secondary.plot(x_age + 0.15, age_group_data['Quality of Sleep'], 
                         marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, 
                         label='Quality of Sleep', color='coral')

ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color='skyblue')
ax6_secondary.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color='coral')
ax6.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xticks(x_age)
ax6.set_xticklabels([str(x) for x in age_group_data.index], rotation=45)

# Combine legends
lines_labels = [ax6.get_legend_handles_labels()[0][0], ax6_secondary.get_legend_handles_labels()[0][0]]
labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines_labels]
ax6.legend(lines_labels, labels, loc='upper right')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
